newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks lunge to new unofficial record.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks lunge to new unofficial record.

text.p: Mexican stocks held on to earlier strong advances to set yet another unofficial record on Thursday.

Analysts and dealers said share prices climbed as a strong performance on Wall Street encouraged heavy buying by domestic and foreign investors amid a bull market fuelled by recent strong economic data.
Preliminary data showed the leading IPC share index ended up 69.36 points, or 1.62 percent, at a historic level of 4,350.88.
